685d51.title: Initial Recon Plan
685d51.content:
Black-box assessment of http://host.docker.internal:8080

Plan:
1. Verify target is reachable
2. Determine tech stack and application type
3. Map attack surface (endpoints, forms, parameters)
4. Understand authentication/authorization model
5. Enumerate user roles and permissions
6. Begin targeted vulnerability testing

Starting with basic connectivity and tech fingerprinting.
